variants.source_summary: Checkout latency rose as processor timeouts caused retry amplification.
variants.recurrence_query: Checkout is slow, processor timeouts are rising, and retries are multiplying.
variants.root_cause: Retry amplification overloaded an unhealthy downstream processor.
variants.resolution_action: Inspect processor health and throttle retry fanout before changing worker capacity.
variants.resolution_observation: Timeout rate and queue depth recovered after retry fanout was throttled.
variants.gold_lesson: Inspect downstream processor timeout rate and queue depth, then throttle retry fanout. Do not scale workers while downstream health is unresolved.

variants.source_summary: Search indexing lag grew when failed shard requests fanned out retries.
variants.recurrence_query: Indexing lag and shard timeouts are rising while retry volume multiplies.
variants.root_cause: Retry fanout amplified shard timeouts and queue pressure.
variants.resolution_action: Inspect shard timeout rate and throttle retry fanout before scaling index workers.
variants.resolution_observation: Shard queues recovered after retry fanout was reduced.
variants.gold_lesson: Inspect shard timeouts and queue depth, then throttle retry fanout. Avoid scaling index workers until shard health recovers.
